title: CPF Module Schema: MSSQL Server module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-mssqlserver'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

admin_group_name.description: (Optional) The group name of the Azure AD Administrator of this MS SQL Server.

admin_object_id.description: (Optional) The object id of the Azure AD Administrator of this SQL Server.

admin_user_email.description: (Optional) The email of the Azure AD Administrator of this MS SQL Server.

admin_username.description: (Optional) The login username of the Azure AD Administrator of this SQL Server.

administrator_login.description: (Optional) The administrator login name for the new server.

administrator_login_password.description: (Optional) The password associated with the administrator_login user. Needs to comply with Azure's Password Policy

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

auditing_policy.type: object({ storage_account_id = string retention_in_days = optional(number, 0) enabled = optional(bool, true) log_monitoring_enabled = optional(bool, true) audit_microsoft_support_operations = optional(bool, true) })
auditing_policy.description: (Optional) An auditing policy block as defined below object({ storage_account_id = "(Required) The ID of the Storage Account to hold all extended auditing logs." retention_in_days = "(Optional) The number of days to retain logs for in the storage account.Defaults to 0." enabled = "(Optional) Whether to enable the extended auditing policy." log_monitoring_enabled = "(Optional) Enable audit events to Azure Monitor? To enable server audit events to Azure Monitor, please enable its main database audit events to Azure Monitor." audit_microsoft_support_operations = "(Optional) Enable auditing of Microsoft support operations tracks Microsoft support engineers' (DevOps) operations on your server." })

azuread_admin_authentication.description: (Optional) Specifies whether AD Users and administrators (e.g. azuread_administrator[0].login_username) can be used to login, or also local database users (e.g. administrator_login). When true, the administrator_login and administrator_login_password properties can be omitted.

azuread_authentication_only.description: (Optional) Specifies whether only AD Users and administrators (e.g. azuread_administrator[0].login_username) can be used to login, or also local database users (e.g. administrator_login). When true, the administrator_login and administrator_login_password properties can be omitted.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

cmk_rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
cmk_rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

customer_managed_key.type: object({ key_vault_id = string expiration_date = string identity_principal_id = string })
customer_managed_key.description: (Required) An customer_managed_key block as defined below object({ key_vault_id = "(Required) The resource ID of the Key Vault where the Key Vault Key resides." expiration_date = "(Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z')." identity_principal_id = "(Required) The principal ID of the User Assigned Identity that has access to the key." })

data_encryption_key.description: (Optional) ID of the key for Transparent Data Encryption.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

firewall_rules.type: map(object({ name = string start_ip_address = string end_ip_address = string }))
firewall_rules.description: (Optional) A map of firewall rules block supports the following: object({ name = "(Required) The name of the firewall rule. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." start_ip_address = "(Required) The starting IP address to allow through the firewall for this rule." end_ip_address = "(Required) The ending IP address to allow through the firewall for this rule." })

identity.description: (Required) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this MS SQL Server. Possible values are UserAssigned, SystemAssigned, UserAssigned (to enable both)." identity_ids = "(Required) Specifies a list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this MS SQL Server. This is required for setting TDE for giving access to CMK key vault key. The first element will be made primary_user_assigned_identity_id. This should be given if type is UserAssigned or SystemAssigned, UserAssigned" })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Key Vault related tags to be set on key vault child resources.

public_network_access_enabled.description: (Optional) Whether public network access is allowed for this server.

resource_group_name.description: (Optional) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

security_alert_policy.type: object({ enabled = optional(bool, false) state = optional(string, "Enabled") disabled_alerts = optional(list(string), []) email_account_admins = optional(bool, true) email_addresses = optional(list(string), []) retention_days = optional(number, 0) storage_endpoint = optional(string, null) storage_account_access_key = optional(string, null) })
security_alert_policy.description: (Optional) A security alert policy block as defined below object({ enabled = "(Optional) Boolean flag to enable or disable the security alert policy resource. Defaults to false." state = "(Optional) Specifies the state of the policy, whether it is enabled or disabled. Possible values are Enabled and Disabled. Defaults to Enabled." disabled_alerts = "(Optional) Specifies an array of alerts that are disabled. Allowed values are: Sql_Injection, Sql_Injection_Vulnerability, Access_Anomaly, Data_Exfiltration, Unsafe_Action, Brute_Force." email_account_admins = "(Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if the alert is sent to the account administrators or not. Defaults to true." email_addresses = "(Optional) Specifies an array of email addresses to which the alert is sent." retention_days = "(Optional) Specifies the number of days to keep in the Threat Detection audit logs. Defaults to 0." storage_endpoint = "(Optional) Specifies the blob storage endpoint (e.g. https://example.blob.core.windows.net). This blob storage will hold all Threat Detection audit logs." storage_account_access_key = "(Optional) Specifies the identifier key of the Threat Detection audit storage account." })

server_name.description: (Optional) The Principal Name of the Azure AD Administrator of this MS SQL Server.

server_version.description: (Optional) The version for the new server. Valid values are: 2.0 (for v11 server) and 12.0 (for v12 server).

service_principal.description: (Optional) The email of the Azure AD Administrator of this MS SQL Server.

storage_account_primary_blob_endpoint.description: (Required) The endpoint URL for blob storage in the primary location.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

vnet_rules.description: (Optional) A map of vnet rules block supports the following: object({ name = "(Required) The name of the SQL virtual network rule. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." subnet_id = "(Required) The ID of the subnet from which the SQL server will accept communications." })

vulnerability_assessment.type: object({ enabled = optional(bool, false) storage_container_path = optional(string, null) storage_account_access_key = optional(string, null) recurring_scans = optional(object({ enabled = optional(bool, true) email_subscription_admins = optional(bool, true) emails = optional(list(string), []) }), {}) })
vulnerability_assessment.description: (Optional) A vulnerability assessment block as defined below object({ enabled = "(Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if vulnerability assessment is enabled. Defaults to false." storage_container_path = "(Optional) A blob storage container path to hold the scan results (e.g. https://example.blob.core.windows.net/vulnerability-assessment/)." storage_account_access_key = "(Optional) Specifies the identifier key of the storage account for vulnerability assessment scan results." recurring_scans = object({ enabled = "(Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if recurring scans is enabled. Defaults to true." email_subscription_admins = "(Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if the schedule scan notification will be sent to the subscription administrators. Defaults to true." emails = "(Optional) Specifies an array of email addresses to which the scan notification is sent." }) })

id.description: The ID of the created SQL server.

name.description: The name of the created SQL server.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Mssqlserver' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
